name: Goblin Invaders
summary: At the Barrens and Stonetalon border, Goblin Invaders strike at the mountains' ancient woodlands. Seereth Stonebreak sends the Horde against Venture Company loggers in Windshear Crag.

sections.title: A Forest in Agony
sections.body:
Venture Company loggers cut deep into the Stonetalon Mountains. They strip the hillsides and burn the underbrush, leaving scorched ground behind. For tauren and their allies, the harm reaches beyond the forests. The primal spirits bound to Stonetalon howl in torment.

Seereth Stonebreak watches from the mountain border. She sees the goblins' assault has left the spirits blind with agony and fury.

sections.title: The Language of Force
sections.body:
Profit is all the Venture Company's executives and hirelings heed. Reason will not sway them. So Seereth sends you past Greatwood Vale and into Windshear Crag to kill fifteen loggers.

The Horde meets the company's greed with force. The blow is meant to halt the deforestation and give tauren elders time to soothe the land's agitated spirits.

faq.answer: Seereth Stonebreak is an orc shaman stationed near the southern boundary between the Barrens and the Stonetalon Mountains. She watches hostile factions encroach and works to protect the region's spiritual balance.

faq.q: Why are the goblins deforesting Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: The Venture Company pursues profit without regard for the damage it causes. It harvests Stonetalon's ancient forests and mineral-rich hills to process and sell, heedless of the natural and spiritual devastation left behind.

aliases: where to find venture co loggers
faq.answer: Windshear Crag lies in the central Stonetalon Mountains. From the Barrens border, follow the mountain road northwest through Greatwood Vale to the crag. There, the forest gives way to Venture Company logging camps and clear-cut hills.

faq.q: How do the spirits react to the Venture Company's presence?
faq.answer: Seereth Stonebreak says the land spirits suffer near-madness from rage and pain caused by logging and burning. Their suffering disrupts nature's balance and threatens the region's spiritual well-being.

faq.q: What happens after culling the Venture Company loggers?
faq.answer: Killing the loggers is only the first blow against the operation. Seereth next directs the Horde against the company's machinery and recommends seeking tauren elders, who can help soothe the wounded spirits.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about logging in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: The tauren hold the Stonetalon Mountains dear for their culture and spiritual life. The Horde also sees the Venture Company's unchecked aggression and theft of resources as threats to its influence in the region and to spiritual harmony.

angles.text: As a tauren, you have urgent cause to confront the Venture Company. Its destruction of Stonetalon's forests torments the earth spirits you honor with the Earth Mother.
As a druid, you see the destruction of living groves and ancient trees in Windshear Crag as an assault on the natural order you defend.
As a shaman, you can feel local elementals and nature spirits crying out, blinded by fury amid smoke and goblin machinery's destruction.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure the borderlands between the Barrens and the higher passes. That keeps hostile commercial syndicates from fortifying central Kalimdor.
